question: Should OpenClaw officially support Android/Termux as a Gateway host, and if so should that be a Termux service adapter, foreground-only Gateway mode, or an Android app-hosted Gateway?
rationale: The request crosses Gateway service lifecycle, Android background execution, dashboard exposure, remote access, updates, and security posture; code inspection confirms the behavior is not already implemented and automation should not choose the product boundary.

options.title: Keep canonical design issue
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define the supported Android Gateway-hosting scope and required real-device proof.

options.title: Declare Android node-only
options.body: Close after a maintainer explicitly decides Android should remain a companion node and docs should direct full-Gateway users to external projects or another host.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow prototype
options.body: Ask for a focused proof PR or design doc for one mode, such as foreground-only Termux Gateway with no service install promise.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical design issue
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define the supported Android Gateway-hosting scope and required real-device proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses Gateway service lifecycle and Android docs, and current history shows steipete carrying the relevant Gateway service and docs boundary work.
